settings.text: At FenderTec, we maintain a large stock of standard rubber fenders to ensure fast delivery. In addition to our standard range, we have the capability to manufacture practically any fender profile design, tailored to your specific requirements.

We can quickly manufacture fenders in nearly any design, tailored to your needs. Our flexible production allows for various rubber grades and hardness levels, ensuring the right fit for your application.

settings.text: Our production facilities allow us to create fenders in different rubber grades and hardness levels, meeting a wide variety of applications and requirements. Whether you need flexibility or extra strength, we have the right solution.
Each fender can be produced according to your exact specifications, ensuring a perfect fit. From standard shapes to complex profiles, we deliver high-quality products with consistent performance.

settings.title: Custom-Length Fenders
settings.text: Rubber fenders can be precisely cut to the desired length using guillotines or sawing machines. This ensures a perfect fit on site, reducing the need for additional finishing work and simplifying installation.

settings.title: Pre-curved Cornerbends
settings.text: We specialize in pre-curved cornerbends for rubber fenders, produced in various radii and rubber qualities to match specific vessel shapes. This ensures a seamless fit around bows and sterns, improving protection and aesthetics.

settings.title: Pre-Drilled Fenders
settings.text: Our facilities can drill rubber fenders in any shape or pattern required. Standard fenders are available pre-drilled from stock, and custom orders can be fulfilled with short production times to meet project deadlines.
We can manufacture practically any fender design to meet your needs. Please don’t hesitate to contact us to discuss your project or fill in the form below for tailored advice from our team.
In our download section you will find the latest editions of our fender brochures. Please download our latest fender catalogue for more interesting product information.
